blurb:
Experience a day you will never forget on the Sip of Montréal Brew Tour. We are the only specialized beer tour by bus that can drive you around Montreal and bring you to the best breweries.

Ranked as one of the top beer cities in North America, indulge your taste buds as we give you a backstage pass to some of the best craft breweries & neighborhoods in town. You will get a flight of beer at every brewery, you will learn about how beer is made and taste different beer styles that have been around for hundreds of years, get a snack and have a designated driver (beer guide).
